Verbunt & van Gent identify it with ω Centauri (2012, sect. 5.4) — a globular cluster of millions of stars, which Ptolemy recorded as an ordinary star of the fifth magnitude. Its own stars fall far below the Bright Star Catalogue's limit, so nothing carried here can place it.
